body:
# v1.23.0 — 降低常驻负载，看清存储与上传状态

macOS build 49。

## 持续监测，减少重复计算

- 修复菜单栏外观回调反复生成整套动画帧的问题。仅在可见内容、主题、尺寸或显示缩放变化时重建，保留原有 30 fps 动画与监测频率。
- 本机用量改为增量处理变化会话及其关联分支，持久化轻量索引；界面只加载最近 35 天，无变化时复用统计结果。磁盘上的旧记录不删除。
- 一台 10 核、16 GiB Mac 的现场测量中，进程平均 CPU 从旧版约 95.39%（61 秒）降至约 9.07%（新版 10 分钟）；100% 表示一个核心。新版物理内存采样约 121–177 MiB，旧版重启后约 346 MiB。结果取决于机器、日志规模与活跃任务，不是所有设备的保证。

## 存储与上传可核查

- 用量设置显示本地数据库及日志占用、原始 Codex 日志大小、额度重试队列大小，以及已确认、待上传、拒绝和仅本地记录数。
- 显示最近上传回执、最早待传记录与重试时间；提供只读云端核验，按当前成员、设备和固定时间范围比较记录数及各项 token 总量。
- 修复额度快照包含不被服务端使用的完整利用率历史，导致请求过大、HTTP 413 和重试积压的问题。新请求和旧队列重试均按团队接口精简；失败继续保留待重试文件，旧绑定数据保持隔离。
- 未绑定上传目标的历史不等于已备份，不会自动补传。现有额度队列容量上限不变，长期断网仍可能淘汰最旧快照；本机 token 事件使用独立持久化队列。

## 数据保留边界

本次只减少内存加载，不启用自动删除或有损历史汇总。最近明细、较早按日、更远按月的分级保留仍是后续方案；未确认上传记录应保留原始事件。Codex 管理的原始日志不由本软件清理。

---

# v1.23.0 — Lower background load, visible storage and delivery status

macOS build 49.

## Keep monitoring with less repeated work

- Fix appearance callbacks repeatedly rebuilding every menu-bar animation frame. Rebuild only when visible content, appearance, size or display scale changes; retain 30 fps playback and existing monitoring intervals.
- Process changed local-usage sessions and their related branches incrementally, persist lightweight indexes, and reuse unchanged statistics. Load only the latest 35 days into the interface while retaining older records on disk.
- On one 10-core, 16 GiB Mac, average process CPU fell from 95.39% over 61 seconds to 9.07% over a ten-minute run. Here 100% means one CPU core. Sampled physical memory was approximately 121–177 MiB versus 346 MiB after restarting the old version. Results depend on hardware, log volume and active tasks; these are not universal guarantees.

## Inspect storage and delivery

- Usage settings show database and journal bytes, original Codex log size, quota retry-queue bytes, and acknowledged, pending, rejected and local-only record counts.
- Show the latest upload acknowledgement, oldest pending record and retry time. A read-only cloud check compares record counts and all token totals for the current member, device and a fixed time range.
- Fix oversized quota snapshots causing HTTP 413 and retry backlogs. New uploads and queued retries omit full utilization histories that the team endpoint does not consume. Failed retries retain their files, and legacy bindings remain isolated.
- Unbound history is not a cloud backup and is not automatically uploaded. The existing quota queue limit remains; prolonged outages can still evict its oldest snapshots. Local token events use a separate durable outbox.

## Retention boundaries

This release reduces in-memory history without deleting or lossily aggregating stored events. Recent detail, older daily summaries and distant monthly summaries remain a future retention proposal. Unacknowledged events should retain their original records. Original logs managed by Codex are not cleaned by this app.

name: v1.22.0 — 更清楚的菜单栏图标与准确的 GLM 状态
body:
# v1.22.0 — 更清楚的菜单栏图标与准确的 GLM 状态

本次包含 v1.21.0 以来的全部改动，macOS 构建号 48。

## 小尺寸也能分清状态

- 菜单栏中心改为双向扇形：上方亮表示余量，下方亮表示透支，只有中心点亮表示节奏正常。未知节奏保持灰色，避免被误认为正常。
- 中心覆盖面积增大，顶部开口扩大到 104°，服务商字母略微上移；C / K / M / G 始终可见，小尺寸下不再与环端头挤在一起。
- 外环继续显示所选周期的剩余额度。黄色表示低额度；获取失败、数据不可用或 Codex 网络不通时显示红色横杠，有最后已知额度时保留该数值的外环。
- 分档与连续节奏模式继续可用。自检演示透支、正常与余量；活跃任务光带沿外环运动，避开顶部字母，悬停时继续显示节奏和动画。
- 修复最终菜单栏图片被系统模板化后丢失警告颜色的问题，并为自检与断网脉冲生成完整动画帧。浅色、深色及屏幕倍率变化会重新生成图标；遵循系统“减少动态效果”设置。
- 修正任务光带在顶部缺口处跳接的问题：按完整圆周运动，在字母开口处遮挡；30 fps、16 段平滑渐变，外环不再整体淡化。
- 每帧同时携带原生 1× / 2× 图像，跨屏显示不放大低分辨率缓存；位置对齐像素，按真实时间播放并保留刷新前后的运动相位。
- 修复 GLM 外环和中心节奏未跟随所选周周期的问题；5h 缺少重置时间时，按最近五小时的实际采样绘制曲线并正确归为短周期，不虚构重置时间或节奏。
- GLM 个人网页凭证可读取独立的可用重置次数与最近到期时间；只读展示，过期次数不计入额度，不执行兑换，查询失败不影响常规额度。

## 统一应用和网站图形

- 启动图标采用 A 标识与同一套扇形语言；警告弹窗、移动仪表盘主屏幕图标、官网品牌图标、favicon 和首页动态演示同步更新。
- 中英文设置说明及 README 同步解释余量、透支、警告和不可用状态。

## 团队网页细节

- 简化团队页顶部区域，退出登录移入面板工具行，页脚补充首页链接。
- 筛选与工具控件统一高度、圆角与背景；小时图列间距和轨道底色调整，空闲格保持透明，减少视觉粘连。

# v1.22.0 — Clearer menu-bar icons and accurate GLM status

All changes since v1.21.0. macOS build 48.

## States that remain readable at menu-bar size

- The center now uses two opposing fans: upper segments mean reserve, lower segments mean deficit, and a lit center dot means on pace. Unknown pace stays muted instead of appearing healthy.
- Larger center shapes, a 104° top opening, and a slightly raised provider letter improve separation at small sizes. C / K / M / G stay visible at all times.
- The outer arc continues to show remaining quota for the selected window. Yellow means low quota. Failed or unavailable data and Codex connectivity outages use a red dash, retaining the last known quota arc when available.
- Staged and continuous pace modes remain available. Self-test demonstrates deficit, on pace, and reserve. Active-task waves follow the open ring without crossing the provider letter; hover retains pace and motion.
- Final status-button images preserve warning colors instead of losing them to macOS template rendering. Self-test and offline pulses now have complete animation sequences. Icons regenerate for appearance and backing-scale changes and respect Reduce Motion.
- Task waves now follow a physical circle and are masked through the provider opening instead of jumping between endpoints. Playback uses 30 fps and 16 gradient segments; the quota ring is no longer dimmed during tasks.
- Every frame includes native 1× and 2× images, avoiding low-resolution upscaling across displays. Pixel-aligned placement and elapsed-time playback preserve sharpness and motion phase across refreshes.
- Fix GLM ring and pace indicators ignoring the selected weekly window. When the 5h API omits reset metadata, chart actual samples from the last five hours and classify it as a short window without inventing reset times or pace.
- Show available GLM personal reset allowances and their next expiry when using supported web credentials. This is read-only, excludes expired allowances, never redeems resets, and keeps optional lookup failures separate from quota.

## One visual family across the app and website

- The launch icon uses A and the same fan geometry. Warning panels, mobile dashboard home-screen icons, website branding, favicon, and live homepage demos are updated together.
- Settings descriptions and both READMEs explain reserve, deficit, warning, and unavailable states.

## Team dashboard refinements

- A simpler header places sign-out in the panel toolbar and adds a homepage link in the footer.
- Filter and toolbar controls share consistent heights, corner radii, and backgrounds. Hourly-chart spacing and track backgrounds are refined, with transparent idle cells to prevent visual merging.

# v1.21.0 — 用量月历标注额度重置

本次包含 v1.20.0 以来的全部发布改动，macOS 构建号 47。

## 额度重置，一眼可见

- 用量月历用深绿框标出 Codex 额度重置的日期，悬停即见「09/12 16:09 已重置」这样的具体日期与时间（本地时区，取当天最近一次）。
- 重置记录来自 codex-resets.com 的公开数据，App 在后台自动获取，成功后 6 小时内不重复请求；离线或获取失败时完全不影响用量矩阵。数据仅用于显示，不会上传任何本机信息。

## 悬停气泡贴着格子

- 用量月历和最近 24 小时矩阵的悬停气泡改为跟随所在格子：默认在格子正上方，顶部放不下时自动移到下方，不再遮挡「近 24h」「每格 5m」等标题文字。
- 官网首页的用量演示同步了以上全部改进。

## 官网：团队界面真实复现

- 首页「共享账号」板块改为复现 App「设置 → 团队」的真实界面，不再使用截图。
- 「谁用了多少」板块直接嵌入 /team 面板同款的前端图表组件与示例数据，展示成员对比、月历与 5 分钟矩阵。

body_en:
# v1.21.0 — Quota resets on the usage calendar

All changes since v1.20.0. macOS build 47.

## Quota resets at a glance

- The usage month calendar marks Codex quota reset days with a dark green frame. Hovering shows the exact date and time, e.g. "09/12 16:09 reset" (local time zone, latest reset of that day).
- Reset history comes from the public codex-resets.com feed, fetched quietly in the background and re-checked every 6 hours; when offline or unavailable the usage matrix is unaffected. The data is only displayed, nothing from your Mac is uploaded.

## Hover callouts hug their cell

- Hover callouts in the month calendar and the last-24-hours matrix now follow the hovered cell: above it by default, moved below when the top rows are full, and never covering the "Last 24h" or "5m / cell" captions. The website demo ships the same behavior.

## Website: faithful team previews

- The shared-account section now recreates the app's Settings → Team pane instead of using a screenshot.
- The "who used how much" section embeds the same frontend chart component the /team dashboard ships, with sample data for member comparison, the calendar and 5-minute matrices.

# v1.20.0 — 成员用量图表，建团与团队面板一键直达

- Quota and usage both use team device credentials; the server enforces team scoping so other teams cannot read or delete your data.
- Team isolation covers database primary keys, device identity, caches, upload queues and in-flight responses; switching teams drops stale request results, and old unowned queues are never uploaded.
- Prevents taking over an existing member identity with only a device ID; credentialed requests no longer follow redirects automatically.

- Cross-team data, D1, legacy history and deletion audits are consolidated behind independently authenticated `/admin`, removed from regular settings.

- 邀请码忽略大小写和空格;邀请码无效、名字被占用、设备已绑定、团队已满和触发限速时给出明确错误提示。
- 加入后与原有绑定完全一致:可选把尚未归属的本机历史归属此成员,历史与上报行为不变。

## App 内反馈

- "设置 → 关于"新增反馈表单:昵称与联系方式可选,联系方式仅开发者可见,不会公开展示。
- 提交后实时出现在官网反馈墙(`/feedback`),表单下方提供直达链接;网络错误、限速和内容校验均有明确提示。

## Codex 订阅与账号

- 每月日历在订阅续费/到期当天显示标记:虚线框表示自动续费,实线框表示到期不续费;仅接受与登录观测一致的网页账单元数据,不落盘、不上传,24 小时内有效。
- 左键菜单把当前 Codex 账号固定在账号分组首位,并直接显示账号名;其余账号保持原有顺序。

## 用量视图

- 趋势改为"本月 + 最近 24 小时":完整自然月日历(未来日期保留空位),最近 24 小时按 5 分钟一格共 288 格;菜单打开时每分钟自动推进,跨小时、跨月自动更新。
- 估算成本仅在全部用量记录都有定价时显示,避免把未定价数据误读为零成本。
- 本机用量卡片标签精简为"本机";设置页汇总数字对应本月。

## 服务商图标

- 左键菜单分组名和设置侧栏改用各服务商真实品牌标识(Codex、GLM、Kimi、MiniMax),单色版本跟随菜单深浅色渲染,替代原来的通用符号。

## 官网与服务端

- 新增公开反馈墙 `/feedback` 与 `POST/GET /v1/feedback` 接口:网页同源与 App Bearer 双入口,每小时每 IP 限 5 次,联系方式仅运营后台可见。
- 新增 `/team` 自助团队页面与配套接口;运营后台新增反馈管理(完整列表、隐藏/恢复/删除)。
- 首页演示与样式微调;sitemap 收录反馈页。

## 发布验证

- App 测试:342 项,3 项依赖外部环境的测试跳过,0 失败。
- 本机用量核心测试随 App 测试一并执行;Cloudflare 服务端测试 57 项通过;手机看板前端测试 35 项通过(其中横屏字号断言与 v1.17.1 的"大横屏限制字体继续放大"行为对齐)。
- 构建使用 CodexBar revision `b6e65a83dc471817b7ff7678e68e0204c9dd604f`,与 v1.17.0 起固定的版本一致。

## 安装与范围

- 下载 DMG 后将 App 替换到"应用程序"。公开版仍为 ad-hoc 签名,更新提示提供下载入口,不自动安装。
- 已有设置、本机用量历史和云端绑定保留;尚未连接团队服务的设备不受影响。
name_en: AI Quota Bar v1.18.0 — Feedback, self-serve teams and a fuller usage view
body_en:
# AI Quota Bar v1.18.0 — Feedback, self-serve teams and a fuller usage view

Summarizes all changes since v1.17.1. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon, build 40.

## Self-serve team joining

- Members no longer need credentials issued one Mac at a time: the team lead creates a team on the website's `/team` page and shares the invite code; members enter the code and their name under "Settings → Codex local usage" to join.
- Optional member passphrase: joining a second Mac with the same name requires the passphrase; enrolled devices can set or update it anytime.
- Invite codes ignore case and whitespace; clear errors cover invalid codes, taken names, already-bound devices, full teams and rate limits.
- Joining matches the original binding exactly: optionally attribute not-yet-assigned local history to this member; history and reporting behave the same.

## In-app feedback

- "Settings → About" gains a feedback form: nickname and contact are optional, and contact info is visible only to the developer — never shown publicly.
- Submissions appear instantly on the website feedback wall (`/feedback`), with a direct link below the form; clear errors cover network failures, rate limits and content validation.

## Codex subscription & accounts

- The monthly calendar marks subscription renewal/expiry days: dashed border for auto-renew, solid for expiry without renewal; only web account metadata consistent with sign-in observations is accepted — never persisted, never uploaded, valid for 24 hours.
- The left-click menu pins the current Codex account to the top of the account group and shows the account name directly; other accounts keep their existing order.

## Usage view

- Trends become "this month + last 24 hours": a full calendar-month matrix (future dates kept as empty slots) and the last 24 hours in 288 five-minute cells; the menu advances every minute while open and rolls over across hours and months automatically.
- Estimated cost appears only when every usage record has a price, so unpriced data is never misread as zero cost.
- The local usage card label is shortened to "Local"; settings summary numbers reflect the current month.

## Provider icons

- Left-click menu group names and the settings sidebar now use each provider's real brand mark (Codex, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax), with monochrome variants that follow menu appearance, replacing the generic symbols.

## Website & server

- New public feedback wall at `/feedback` with `POST/GET /v1/feedback`: same-origin web and app Bearer entry points, 5 requests per hour per IP, contact info visible only in the admin console.
- New `/team` self-serve team page with its APIs; the admin console gains feedback management (full list, hide/restore/delete).
- Homepage demo and style polish; sitemap includes the feedback page.

## Release verification

- App tests: 342 total, 3 environment-dependent tests skipped, 0 failures.
- Local-usage core tests run with the app suite; 57 Cloudflare server tests pass; 35 mobile dashboard frontend tests pass (landscape font-size assertions aligned with v1.17.1's "large landscape keeps enlarging type" behavior).
- Built with CodexBar revision `b6e65a83dc471817b7ff7678e68e0204c9dd604f`, pinned since v1.17.0.

## Install & scope

- Download the DMG and replace the app in "Applications". The public build remains ad-hoc signed; update notices link to the download and never install automatically.
- Existing settings, local usage history and cloud bindings are preserved; devices not yet connected to team services are unaffected.

# AI Quota Bar v1.17.1 — 趋势、任务与更轻的菜单

汇总自 v1.17.0 发布以来的全部改动。macOS 14+，Apple Silicon，构建 39。

## 用量与首次使用

- Codex 本机用量改为固定近 30 天日历矩阵，下方展示今日小时小柱图；保留 Tokens、用量记录、缓存命中率、估算成本切换。
- 左键菜单标题缩短为“本机用量 / Local usage”；仍只统计当前登录账号，历史账号选择保留在设置页。
- 悬停沿用周期柱图的浮层样式，不再显示竖向选中线；未定价、零用量、日历空位及未来小时分别呈现。
- 新设备未添加供应商时显示连接引导和可选示例预览，不自动请求未配置的 Codex。示例只在视图内生成，不进入存储、上报或告警。
- 尚未生成 Codex 日志目录时视为正常空状态；实际读取故障继续报告。Codex 暂未运行时引导打开应用，保留历史查看入口。

## 凭据与更新

- 成员上报凭据迁入共享钥匙串字典，与供应商、云同步和看板访问凭据共用缓存；旧凭据兼容迁移。
- 缺失的旧条目缓存查询结果，拒绝访问和损坏数据不再触发后台重复读取；供应商设置的“连接帮助”提供显式重试。
- 左键菜单 Settings 与 Quit 之间增加低强调新版提示；设置同步展示更新状态、下载和日志链接。
- 发现的新版跨重启保留；并发检查去重，检查失败允许 15 分钟后重试，通知提交失败不记录为已提醒。
- 下载仍使用 DMG 手动替换安装，不宣称自动安装。

## 图标与官网

- App 图标采用菜单栏额度圆环和中央节奏指示的黑白灰设计。
- 官网采用中性灰白背景，数据图表保留有意义的状态颜色。
- 增加完整历史版本更新日志与搜索，并提供从 GitHub 同步发布说明的构建脚本。
- 增加按 App 绘制规则实现的自检、空闲、单任务、多任务图标演示，可暂停并尊重减少动态效果设置。
- 看板介绍扩展到同局域网可访问 Mac 的手机、平板、车机及其他电脑浏览器。

## 菜单与同步诊断

- 移除左键菜单的服务商快捷暂停入口；暂停与恢复仍在供应商设置中管理。
- 云端读取错误不再占据菜单空间；设置 → 同步显示当前状态，并增加本机同步日志入口。
- 日志保留最近 200 条读取/上传结果，连续相同结果合并计数，可清空；记录错误代码，不保存 Token、请求地址或响应正文。
- 仅启用云同步的新设备继续等待云端历史，不错误要求添加本机供应商。

## 更完整的官网与跨屏演示

- 首页同时呈现左右键面板，独立介绍任务睡眠保护、可选合盖工作、线路测速切换及活跃连接。
- 首页与更新日志统一使用 App 图标；圆环以真实菜单栏尺寸自动轮换自检、空闲、单任务和多任务，保留手动探索与暂停。
- 官网本机用量演示同步为 30 天矩阵和今日小时柱，移除旧时间范围切换与暂停入口。
- 浏览器看板同时展示横屏亮色与竖屏暗色，使用 App 的实际前端及独立示例数据。
- 大横屏限制字体继续放大，为额度、任务与连接数据留出更多空间；手机原有自适应保留。
- 仓库 About 补充官网链接与功能介绍。

## 安装与范围

- 下载 DMG 后将 App 替换到“应用程序”。公开版仍为 ad-hoc 签名，更新提示提供下载入口，不自动安装。
- 自助创建团队、邀请设备加入仍在规划中；本次不把已有的成员归属上报描述为完整自助团队系统。
name_en: AI Quota Bar v1.17.1 — Trends, tasks and a lighter menu
body_en:
# AI Quota Bar v1.17.1 — Trends, tasks and a lighter menu

Summarizes all changes since v1.17.0. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon, build 39.

## Usage & first run

- Codex local usage is now a fixed last-30-days calendar matrix with today's hourly bars below; the Tokens / records / cache hit rate / estimated cost switch remains.
- The left-click menu header is shortened to "Local usage"; it still measures only the signed-in account, and per-account history stays in Settings.
- Hovering keeps the cycle-bar callout style and drops the vertical selection line; unpriced, zero-usage, calendar padding and future hours are each presented distinctly.
- New devices without a provider see connection guidance and an optional sample preview; no automatic requests to unconfigured Codex. Samples are generated in-view only — never stored, reported or alerted.
- A missing Codex log directory is treated as a normal empty state; real read failures still surface. When Codex isn't running, the card points you to the app while keeping history access.

## Credentials & updates

- Member reporting credentials move into a shared keychain dictionary, sharing the cache with provider, cloud sync and dashboard credentials; legacy credentials migrate transparently.
- Missing legacy entries cache the failed lookup, and access-denied or corrupted data no longer triggers repeated background reads; the provider settings "Connection help" offers an explicit retry.
- The left-click menu gains a low-key new-version hint between Settings and Quit; Settings mirrors update status with download and changelog links.
- Discovered updates survive restarts; concurrent checks are deduplicated, failed checks can retry after 15 minutes, and a failed notification submission is not counted as "reminded".
- Downloads still use the DMG for manual replacement — no automatic installation is claimed.

## Icon & website

- The app icon adopts a black-white-gray design of the menu bar quota ring and central pace indicator.
- The website moves to a neutral gray-white palette while charts keep meaningful status colors.
- Adds a full versioned changelog with search, plus a build script that syncs release notes from GitHub.
- Adds self-test / idle / single-task / multiple-task icon demos implemented with the app's actual drawing rules — pausable and respectful of Reduce Motion.
- The dashboard section now covers phones, tablets, car browsers and other computer browsers that can reach the Mac on the LAN.

## Menu & sync diagnostics

- Removes the provider quick-pause shortcut from the left-click menu; pausing and resuming stay in provider settings.
- Cloud read errors no longer occupy menu space; Settings → Sync shows the current state with a link to local sync logs.
- Logs keep the last 200 read/upload results, merging consecutive identical results with counts, and can be cleared; error codes are recorded — never tokens, request URLs or response bodies.
- Cloud-sync-only new devices keep waiting for cloud history instead of being wrongly asked to add a local provider.

## A fuller website & cross-device demo

- The homepage shows the left- and right-click panels together, introducing task sleep protection, optional lid-closed work, route testing/switching and active connections.
- Homepage and changelog share the app icon; the ring auto-cycles self-test, idle, single-task and multiple-task at true menu bar size, with manual exploration and pause.
- The website's local usage demo now mirrors the 30-day matrix and today's hourly bars, dropping the old range switcher and pause entry.
- The browser dashboard shows landscape light and portrait dark side by side, using the app's actual frontend with separate sample data.
- Large landscapes stop enlarging fonts further, leaving more room for quota, task and connection data; the phone's adaptive layout remains.
- The repository About section gains the website link and a feature summary.

## Install & scope

- Download the DMG and replace the app in "Applications". The public build remains ad-hoc signed; update notices link to the download and never install automatically.
- Self-serve team creation, invited device joining and similar are still in planning; this release does not describe existing member attribution reporting as a full self-serve team system.

name: AI Quota Bar v1.17.0
body:
# AI Quota Bar v1.17.0

本次发布汇总 **v1.16.0 发布以来的全部改动**：从只看共享账号额度，扩展到本机 Codex 消耗与历史账号统计，并整合菜单、设置、云服务、运营后台和产品官网。

## Codex 本机用量与历史

- 从本机 Codex 的 sessions / archived_sessions 日志增量统计 Tokens、有效用量记录、缓存命中率与 API 等价值估算成本；支持今天按小时、7 天 / 30 天按天查看趋势。
- 展示输入、输出、缓存读写、模型分布、解析异常和价格覆盖情况。SQLite 持久化解析缓存与待上传队列，重启后继续处理，避免每次重扫全部历史。
- 对重复快照、归档副本、续页、分叉继承及累计值回退进行去重或异常处理；缺失父会话时暂缓统计，不猜测缺失用量。
- 优先使用日志中的账号信息，缺失时参考连续的本机登录观测；无法确认归属的历史单独保留为“账号未知”，不会全部归到当前登录账号。
- 支持导入带生效日期的模型单价。未知价格保留“未定价”，不伪装成零成本；估算并非供应商账单，记录数也不等于全部 HTTP 请求数。

## 菜单与设置

- Codex 供应商置顶，本机统计与额度信息集中在同一组；左键菜单聚焦当前 Codex 账号，去掉历史账号选择器，历史账号在设置中查看。
- 保留历史趋势，支持切换 Tokens / 用量记录 / 缓存命中率 / 成本并悬停查看时段数据；交互控件使用统一的中性色。
- 新增统一“显示”设置，将菜单显隐、手机模型选择和图表样式整合为账号 / 模型矩阵，减少重复设置。
- 账号总开关保留各模型的选择；手机维持 1–2 项限制；隐藏不影响采集、历史、告警或同步，暂不可用模型的已有选择仍保留。

## 成员与设备用量上报

- 新增独立的成员 / 设备绑定和用量上报开关，设备凭据保存在钥匙串；后台支持设备凭据签发、轮换和撤销。
- 支持按成员、设备、账号及时间范围查看统计；同一事件重复上传不重复计数，跨成员归属冲突隔离处理。
- 持久化补传、网络失败退避和绑定切换保护；历史用量是否归属、补传由用户明确选择。
- **当前仍需要管理员配置设备绑定。自助创建团队、一次性加入码和邀请加入流程尚未发布。**

## 云服务与运营后台

- 默认云端入口迁移到 `https://ai-quota-bar.pages.dev`，现有额度历史和用量数据保留；云端独立于旧部署资源运行。
- 新增 `/admin` 运营后台，支持独立管理员登录、匿名安装设备数、日 / 周 / 月活、7 / 30 / 90 天趋势及 App / macOS 版本分布。
- 匿名运营统计默认关闭，可在“设置 → 通用 → 隐私”开启或停止并删除本机统计；不采集 Codex 邮箱、对话内容或用量成本。
- 启动或打开菜单 / 设置计为活跃，后台心跳不计入日活。匿名安装数不等于真实用户数，也不包含旧版本和未开启统计的设备。

## 官网与手机看板修复

- 官网新增产品介绍和可交互的菜单、用量、显示设置及连接监控局部复现，全部用前端绘制，不使用截图。
- 手机演示直接复用 App 的前端组件，以示例数据展示任务、配额、线路、连接及保护状态；演示不会读取访问者的 App 数据。
- 重新梳理跨周期趋势、共享账号下的本机消耗、任务保护和连接诊断等核心功能，完善桌面和窄屏布局。
- 修复手机看板状态条条目数量变化时的渲染异常，避免额度 / 保护信息更新导致后续线路和连接区域空白。

## 下载与升级

下载 `AIQuotaBar.dmg`，将 App 拖入“应用程序”替换旧版。系统要求 macOS 14+，发布制品为 Apple Silicon（arm64），版本 1.17.0（build 35）。原有设置和本地历史保留；首次读取大量 Codex 历史可能需要数分钟。

公开 DMG 延续 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证。如首次打开被 macOS 拦截，可在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”按系统提示允许。升级后读取原钥匙串凭据可能需要再次授权。

更新检查仍采用现有的定期检查 / 系统通知与设置中的手动检查，下载跳转到 GitHub Release；本次没有引入自动安装器或左键菜单更新横幅。

## 发布验证

- App 测试：319 项，3 项依赖外部环境的测试跳过，0 失败。
- 本机用量核心测试：28 项，未启动本地 HTTP 测试服务时跳过 1 项，0 失败。
- Cloudflare 服务端：36 项通过；手机看板前端：35 项通过。
- 构建使用 CodexBar revision `b6e65a83dc471817b7ff7678e68e0204c9dd604f`，源码构建说明已固定该版本。
- 另行启动本地 Worker 后，Swift 客户端真实 HTTP 集成测试通过（身份绑定、重复上传去重和汇总）。
- DMG 挂载后版本、build、二进制一致性、深度签名和镜像完整性均验证通过。
- `AIQuotaBar.dmg` SHA-256：`a5707c7c4affb4407cb84f7f82800eda3c55f6397e03cd28e9e0d0a45eeadafc`。
body_en:
# AI Quota Bar v1.17.0

This release summarizes **everything since v1.16.0**: from shared-account quota only to on-device Codex consumption and per-account history, integrated across the menu, settings, cloud services, the admin console and the product website.

## Codex local usage & history

- Incrementally measures tokens, valid usage records, cache hit rate and API-equivalent estimated cost from this Mac's Codex sessions / archived_sessions logs; today by hour, and 7/30-day trends by day.
- Shows input, output, cache reads/writes, model mix, parse issues and price coverage. SQLite persists the parse cache and pending upload queue so restarts resume instead of rescanning everything.
- Deduplicates repeat snapshots, archived copies, continuations, fork inheritance and cumulative-value regressions; statistics pause when a parent session is missing rather than guessing usage.
- Account information from the logs wins; when missing, consecutive local sign-in observations are used. History that can't be attributed stays as "Unknown account" instead of being charged to the current login.
- Supports importing model prices with effective dates. Unknown prices stay "Unpriced" and never masquerade as zero cost; estimates are not a provider bill, and record counts are not all HTTP requests.

## Menu & settings

- The Codex provider is pinned to the top with local statistics and quota in one group; the left-click menu focuses on the current Codex account — the history account picker moves to Settings.
- History trends remain, with Tokens / records / cache hit rate / cost switching and hover inspection; interactive controls use a unified neutral palette.
- A unified "Display" pane combines menu visibility, mobile model selection and chart style into one account / model matrix, reducing duplicated settings.
- The account master switch preserves individual model choices; mobile keeps its 1–2 item limit; hiding never affects collection, history, alerts or sync, and unavailable models keep their prior selections.

## Member & device usage reporting

# AI Quota Bar v1.13.0

This release summarizes everything since v1.12.2: cycle-end aligned refreshes, menu panel chart fixes, source-aware mobile dashboard adaptation, cloud read retries and closed-lid observability.

## Cycle-end aligned refresh

- 5-hour and weekly windows rarely end exactly on a 10-minute polling tick: now any cycle end triggers a refresh 15 seconds later, and regular polling restarts from that moment so new-cycle data lands immediately.
- Applies only to local providers that can actually be fetched (e.g. Codex models drop out of scheduling when Codex isn't running); cloud-synced models don't trigger the mechanism.

## Menu panel chart fixes

- A transient cloud fetch failure keeps the previous samples — curves no longer vanish suddenly.
- Curves without data no longer keep a fixed-height empty container; the panel shrinks to fit its content.
- Hover previews of past cycles are tinted by that cycle's own usage; an orange warning from the current cycle's low margin no longer leaks into history previews.

## Source-aware mobile dashboard

- With only Kimi tasks running: the Kimi quota card moves to the front, the OpenAI-only connections block and proxy route block hide, and the title becomes "Kimi activity".
- Codex-only or mixed tasks keep the full layout; with no tasks everything shows as usual.
- The snapshot schema bumps to v4 with a new `activeProviders` field; older snapshots parse compatibly.

## Cloud read auto-retry

- The read path auto-retries transient network errors — timeouts, DNS failures, TLS breaks, lost connections — with exponential backoff, matching the write path; 4xx/5xx server errors are not self-healing and fail immediately.
- Network error messages are unified into clear Chinese copy (e.g. "Request timed out: the link to the sync server is unreachable — check whether your proxy covers this domain").

## Closed-lid observability

- App and privileged helper gain OSLog logging: lease acquire/release/expire and re-asserting after external tools clear SleepDisabled are all searchable in Console (subsystem `com.techfanseric.aiquotabar` / `.sleep-helper`).
- The helper's lease sweep interval drops from 15s to 5s, shortening the conflict window when external power-management tools rewrite `disablesleep`.

## 本地样本缓存

- 消耗样本改为合并式写入并保留 90 天，重装新版或重启后历史曲线不再丢失。
- 每个模型的样本量设上限并自动裁剪最旧数据，缓存体积可控。

# AI Quota Bar v1.12.2

This release summarizes everything since v1.11.0: unified chart time-axis rules, local sample caching, past-cycle previews, cloud status diagnostics and hardened sleep protection.

## Chart time axes align to natural boundaries

- Multi-day window dividers align to local midnight (previously cycle start + 24h), so you can tell which day is which at a glance.
- Single-day windows (e.g. 5 hours) align to local whole hours (previously start + N hours).
- Hover labels only cover segments fully inside the window: multi-day windows show `MM/dd` centered on that day's noon, single-day windows show `3PM`-style labels at the half hour; partial edge segments are unlabeled.
- The multi-day progress bar (weekly window) also labels only complete days, centered at noon.

## Local sample cache

- Consumption samples switch to merge-style writes retained for 90 days, so history curves survive reinstalls and restarts.
- Per-model sample counts are capped with automatic trimming of the oldest data, keeping cache size in check.

## Past-cycle hover preview

- Hovering any past cycle in the cross-cycle utilization bars instantly switches the chart to that cycle's consumption curve; moving away restores the current cycle.

## Cloud sync status diagnostics

- Cloud sync errors are categorized with specific copy for network timeouts, DNS/connection failures and D1 quota exhaustion — no more generic "request timed out".
- The sync settings page gains a D1 daily usage row (rows read / daily limit) with green/yellow/red thresholds at 50%/80%.
- The Worker adds a read-only `/v1/d1-usage` endpoint (Cloudflare GraphQL analytics source, 5-minute edge cache), already deployed on the default cloud; self-hosters must configure `CF_API_TOKEN` and related switches per [cloudflare/README.md](https://github.com/techfanseric/ai-quota-bar/blob/v1.12.2/cloudflare/README.md) — updating only the Mac app does not upgrade a self-hosted backend.

## Hardened sleep protection

- Power assertions and closed-lid leases survive 5 minutes after a task ends, so gaps between turns and activity-detection jitter no longer put the Mac to sleep mid-task.
- Transient XPC drops no longer release the closed-lid lease immediately; natural lease expiry takes over instead.
- If the kernel SleepDisabled flag is externally cleared (other tools, power switching), the assertion is re-applied automatically.
- Heartbeat leases extend on negotiated timeout, and screen-saver user activity refreshes every 45 seconds.

# AI Quota Bar v1.8.0

v1.8.0 新增了安全、可安装的 Mobile Dashboard，让手机或同一局域网内的另一块屏幕可以持续观察配额、Codex 任务、线路、连接与睡眠保护状态。

## 从手机查看完整运行状态

- 在“Settings → Mobile Dashboard”启用本地仪表盘，通过二维码打开并安装 PWA。
- 最多选择两个配额模型，复用 Mac 端的配额曲线、重置周期和节奏判断。
- Codex Activity、Route 与 Connections 在横屏和竖屏下接近三等分，并随分辨率整体缩放。
- 页面通过实时事件流更新，同时显示当前保护状态、活跃连接、最近线路和最长连接时长。
- 支持自动、浅色和深色外观、OLED 位移保护，以及需要用户主动开启的实验性屏幕唤醒媒体。

## 更真实、更可读的 Task telemetry barrage

- 1 至 5 个活跃 Task 精确对应 1 至 5 行弹幕，每一行只显示同一个任务的信息。
- 可逐项选择标题、状态、阶段、项目、Git 分支、来源、模型、模型提供商、推理强度、沙箱、审批模式、Token、子任务、时间、CLI 版本、工具、最近事件和进展等字段。
- 每个任务的字段顺序独立随机，但实时数据更新时保持稳定，不会引起字幕跳动。
- 五档速度为 `48 / 40 / 34 / 29 / 25 px/s`：新任务更快，运行时间更久的任务更慢，差异清楚但仍便于阅读。
- 新字幕接入当前轨道队列，不会重置滚动位置；单任务时字号会接近 Codex Activity 区块高度。
- 确认进入 IDLE 后，可切换为纯黑白、多行、大小和速度各异的全屏字幕屏保。

## 本地访问与隐私安全

- 提供稳定本地主机名和明确的 IP 备用地址，并支持当前网络地址变化后的重新连接。
- 可选启用五分钟过期的手动配对码；配对后换取可撤销、绑定 Origin 的安装凭证，凭证不会留在保存的 URL 中。
- 默认隐藏账户名称；Task 进展文字只有在要求手动配对并再次明确开启共享后才会离开 Mac。
- 本地服务器采用严格 Host/Origin/CORS/CSP 校验、请求大小限制、配对速率限制和有上限的查看器数量。
- 供应商凭证、云同步 Token 与 Mobile Dashboard Token 统一迁移到带版本、可恢复的 Keychain 凭证保险库。

## 长时间运行与兼容性

- Codex 生命周期读取扩展为逐任务遥测，并覆盖 38 个 CLI 版本族的代表性记录格式。
- 弹幕字段更新保留动画相位；任务数量变化时显式释放旧 Animation 和 DOM 节点。
- 轨道队列、IDLE 特效、SSE 连接、定时器、连接轮询与重连状态均采用有界生命周期。
- 浏览器压力测试连续 30 轮 `5 → 1 → 5` 后，DOM 节点保持 `772 → 772`、事件监听保持 `32 → 32`，并维持精确的 5 条轨道动画。
- 遵循系统“减少动态效果”设置。

## 安装说明

本版本要求 macOS 14 或更高版本，预编译 DMG 面向 Apple Silicon。

公开 DMG 使用 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证。首次打开时如被 Gatekeeper 拦截，请按住 Control 点击应用并选择“打开”，或前往“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”允许打开。不要全局关闭 Gatekeeper。

## 发布验证

- Swift 测试执行 228 项，其中 2 项按环境条件跳过、零失败。
- Mobile Dashboard 前端测试 32/32 通过。
- Release 构建、Hook、特权辅助程序和 DMG 制作成功。
- DMG 完整性及应用深度签名验证通过。
- 镜像内版本：`1.8.0 (22)`；架构：`arm64`。
- DMG SHA-256：`5c839ede27ee124c15c2a5cbc5614e89a7a782c8683200600bf2828a95c81932`

# AI Quota Bar v1.8.0

v1.8.0 adds a safe, installable Mobile Dashboard so a phone or another screen on the same LAN can continuously watch quotas, Codex tasks, routes, connections and sleep protection.

## The full run state, from your phone

- Enable the local dashboard in "Settings → Mobile Dashboard", open it via QR code and install the PWA.
- Pick up to two quota models, reusing the Mac's quota curves, reset cycles and pace judgement.
- Codex Activity, Route and Connections split roughly into thirds in both orientations and scale with resolution.
- The page updates through a live event stream, showing current protection status, active connections, the latest route and the longest connection duration.
- Automatic, light and dark appearances, OLED shift protection, and an experimental screen-wake media option that's off until you enable it.

## A truer, more readable task telemetry barrage

- One to five active tasks map exactly to one to five marquee lines, each line showing only that task's information.
- Choose per field: title, status, phase, project, Git branch, source, model, provider, reasoning effort, sandbox, approval mode, tokens, subtasks, time, CLI version, tools, latest event and progress.
- Each task's field order is randomized independently but stays stable across live updates, so captions never jump.
- Five speeds at `48 / 40 / 34 / 29 / 25 px/s`: newer tasks move faster, longer-running ones slower — distinct yet readable.
- New captions join the current track queue without resetting scroll position; with a single task the font grows toward the Codex Activity block height.
- Confirmed IDLE can switch to a pure black-and-white, multi-line full-screen caption screensaver with mixed sizes and speeds.

## Local access & privacy

- A stable local hostname plus explicit IP fallback, with reconnection after network address changes.
- Optional five-minute manual pairing codes; pairing exchanges for a revocable, Origin-bound install credential that never stays in the saved URL.
- Account names are hidden by default; task progress text leaves the Mac only after manual pairing is required and sharing is explicitly re-enabled.
- The local server enforces strict Host/Origin/CORS/CSP validation, request size limits, pairing rate limits and a capped viewer count.
- Provider credentials, the cloud sync token and the Mobile Dashboard token migrate to a versioned, recoverable keychain vault.

## Long runs & compatibility

- Codex lifecycle reading extends into per-task telemetry, covering representative record formats across 38 CLI version families.
- Marquee field updates preserve animation phase; task count changes explicitly release old animations and DOM nodes.
- Track queues, IDLE effects, SSE connections, timers, connection polling and reconnect state all use bounded lifecycles.
- A browser stress test of 30 rounds of `5 → 1 → 5` held DOM nodes at `772 → 772` and listeners at `32 → 32`, with exactly 5 track animations.
- Respects the system Reduce Motion setting.

## Install

Requires macOS 14 or later; the prebuilt DMG targets Apple Silicon.

The public DMG is ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. If Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, Control-click the app and choose Open, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally.

- Swift tests: 228 executed, 2 environment-skipped, 0 failures.
- Mobile dashboard frontend tests: 32/32 pass.
- Release build, hooks, privileged helper and DMG packaging succeeded.
- DMG integrity and app deep signing verified.

# AI Quota Bar v1.7.0

v1.7.0 的重点，是让菜单栏用更少的信息、更清楚地告诉你两件事：Codex 任务是否仍在工作，以及 OpenAI 当前应该换线路还是继续等待。

## 不打开菜单，也知道 Codex 还在工作

- 没有活跃任务时，剩余配额环保持 100% 实色，方便判断配额。
- 有任务运行时，基础环降为 60%，更容易看到沿剩余配额部分逆时针流动的能量波。
- 每个活跃任务对应一道波，最多显示五道；五个以上任务仍保持五道，避免 22pt 菜单栏图标变得拥挤。
- 波头最实，顺时针方向的长尾逐渐透明，既能看出运动方向，也不会变成突兀的圆点。
- 能量波绝不会进入已经消耗的配额段。
- 开启 macOS“减少动态效果”时，应用会保留静态任务提示。

## 左键配额面板恢复真正的 macOS 原生体验

- 左键面板重新使用系统 `NSMenu`，恢复原生半透明材质、阴影、圆角和菜单行为。
- 面板会根据当前菜单栏图标所在的显示器计算可用高度，减少外接屏、上下排列屏幕或不同菜单栏尺寸造成的错位。
- 左键与右键入口会在打开另一侧前主动收起，避免两个面板重叠。

## 右键控制中心更紧凑、更容易扫读

- 右键面板采用统一宽度、圆角和无三角箭头的边界，不再依赖不同系统环境下位置不稳定的 Popover 箭头。
- 自动恢复开关固定靠右，说明文字保持靠左。
- 线路改为单行布局，并用 `H2`、`VL`、`TLS`、`SS` 等标识快速区分协议。
- 线路和活跃连接列表保留最小浏览高度，数据较少时不会缩成几乎看不见的一行。
- 最近三次换线记录把“从哪里切到哪里”放在左侧；一小时内使用 `59m ago` 这类相对时间，较早记录显示具体时间。
- 没有换线记录时，历史区域自动收起，不浪费空间。

## 更快判断 OpenAI 连接是否健康

- 下载、上传和连接总数保持在图表上方，打开面板即可确认是否真的有数据流动。

- 活跃连接详情从 TCP 等协议字段开始，不再显示没有判断价值的未知进程占位文本。

# AI Quota Bar v1.7.0

v1.7.0 is about the menu bar saying two things more clearly with less: whether a Codex task is still working, and whether OpenAI needs a route change right now — or just more patience.

- With no active tasks, the remaining-quota ring stays a solid 100% for easy reading.
- When tasks run, the base ring drops to 60% so the energy waves flowing counterclockwise along the consumed portion stand out.
- Each active task owns one wave, up to five; beyond five tasks the count stays at five to keep the 22pt icon uncluttered.
- The wave head is most solid and its clockwise tail fades out — showing direction without turning into a distracting dot.

- Available height is computed from the display currently hosting the menu bar icon, reducing misalignment with external displays, stacked screens or different menu bar sizes.
- Left- and right-click entries dismiss each other before opening, so the two panels never overlap.

- The right-click panel uses a consistent width, rounded corners and an arrow-free boundary — no more popover arrows whose position varies across system environments.
- The auto-recovery switch stays pinned right; explanatory text stays left.

- Download, upload and connection totals stay above the chart, so you can confirm data is actually flowing the moment the panel opens.
- The connection-age legend lives in the chart's title row, using `New → Old` for the color shift from fresh to long-lived connections.

# AI Quota Bar v1.6.0

v1.6.0 的重点，是让长时间使用 Codex 和 ChatGPT 变得更省心：任务运行时不再担心 Mac 意外睡眠，连接变慢或中断时也不用来回切换 Clash 查原因。

## 让 Codex 长任务安心跑完

- AI Quota Bar 会显示当前正在工作的 Codex 任务数量。
- 只在任务运行期间保持显示器、阻止屏保和系统空闲睡眠；任务全部完成后自动恢复正常。
- 多个任务同时运行时会分别计数，不会因为其中一个先结束就提前停止保护。
- 如果偶尔需要合上 MacBook 仍让任务继续，可以单独开启合盖模式。第一次使用需要管理员授权，但不要求 Apple Developer 身份。
- 合盖模式会在任务完成、应用失去联系、电量过低、机器过热、用户关闭或达到 12 小时上限时恢复原来的睡眠设置。

## 更快判断 OpenAI 为什么慢

- 右键面板只展示 `openai.com` 与 `chatgpt.com` 的活跃连接，其他流量不会干扰判断。
- 可以直接看到总下载速度、总上传速度和当前连接数。
- 最近 60 分钟图表让连接高峰、空白时段和持续较久的连接更容易被发现。
- 每个连接对应一个色块：新连接为绿色，持续越久越接近橙色。
- 连接列表会在数据可用时展示域名、应用、线路、持续时间和速度。
- 所有连接监控都是只读的，不会关闭连接或改动 Clash 配置。

## OpenAI 断线时少做几步

- 线路和活跃连接现在直接上下排列，不需要切换标签页。
- 右键面板更窄，但线路与连接列表仍保留足够的浏览空间。
- 最近三次换线记录会简短显示；没有记录时不会浪费高度。
- 继续支持 `🇯🇵`、`日本`、`JP` 等国家筛选，也可以用正则精确匹配线路名。
- 可以手动选择线路，也可以在真正断线时，让应用从筛选结果中选择延迟最低的线路。

自动恢复仍然很克制：打开面板、点击测速或打开开关都不会换线。只有 `openai.com` 与 `chatgpt.com` 连续两轮同时不可达时才会开始恢复；连接成功后立即停止并发送系统通知。

## 日常使用更稳定

- 减少启动时等待系统钥匙串的情况，让菜单更快出现。
- 升级应用时会先停止旧版本，再完整替换应用包并重新启动，降低覆盖运行中应用造成异常的概率。
- 补充了任务检测、睡眠保护、连接历史、线路历史和界面布局等自动化测试。
- README 现已提供完整中英文说明，并清楚解释安装方式、隐私边界和合盖使用注意事项。

# AI Quota Bar v1.6.0

v1.6.0 makes long Codex and ChatGPT sessions worry-free: no more worrying about the Mac sleeping mid-task, and no more switching back to Clash to figure out slow or broken connections.

## Let long Codex tasks finish in peace

- AI Quota Bar shows how many Codex tasks are currently working.
- Display, screen saver and idle sleep are held only while tasks run; everything restores automatically when they finish.
- Multiple simultaneous tasks are counted separately — protection doesn't end early just because one finished first.
- If you occasionally need to close the MacBook while a task continues, closed-lid mode can be enabled separately. First use needs administrator approval but no Apple Developer identity.
- Closed-lid mode restores your original sleep settings when tasks complete, the app loses contact, battery runs low, the machine overheats, you switch it off — or the 12-hour cap is reached.

## Diagnosing slow OpenAI faster

- The right-click panel shows only `openai.com` and `chatgpt.com` active connections — other traffic never muddies the picture.
- Total download, total upload and the current connection count are directly visible.
- The last 60 minutes chart makes peaks, idle gaps and long-lived connections easy to spot.
- Each connection is one colored block: green for new, shifting toward orange as it ages.
- When data is available, the list shows domain, app, route, duration and speed.
- All connection monitoring is read-only — no closing connections or editing Clash configuration.

## Fewer steps when OpenAI drops

- Routes and active connections now stack vertically — no tab switching.
- The right-click panel is narrower while keeping enough browsing space for routes and connections.
- The last three switches show briefly; with no history, no height is wasted.
- Country filters like `🇯🇵`, `日本`, `JP` keep working, plus regex matching for precise route names.
- Choose routes manually, or on a real outage let the app pick the lowest-latency route from your filter results.

Auto-recovery stays conservative: opening the panel, testing speed or toggling the switch never changes routes by itself. Recovery starts only when `openai.com` and `chatgpt.com` are unreachable together for two consecutive rounds, stops immediately on success, and sends a system notification.

## Steadier daily use

- Less waiting on the system keychain at launch, so the menu appears faster.
- Upgrades now stop the old version before fully replacing the bundle and relaunching, reducing corruption from overwriting a running app.
- Automated tests added for task detection, sleep protection, connection history, route history and layout.
- The README is now fully bilingual, clearly explaining installation, privacy boundaries and closed-lid caveats.

## Install

Requires macOS 14 or later; the prebuilt DMG targets Apple Silicon.

The public DMG is ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. If Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, Control-click the app and choose Open, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally.

## Interface preview

![AI Quota Bar v1.6.0 control center](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techfanseric/ai-quota-bar/v1.6.0/docs/images/control-center.png)

## Release verification

- 101 automated tests pass with zero failures.
- 2 locally disabled tests for live Clash streaming and the panel were additionally enabled and passed.
- Release build, hooks, privileged helper and DMG packaging succeeded.

name: AI Quota Bar v1.5.0
body:
## 重磅更新：OpenAI 路由自动恢复

右键菜单栏图标即可直接管理 OpenAI 路由，无需切回 Clash：

- 自动发现 Clash Verge Rev、Mihomo 或 Clash 的本地控制器。
- 自动定位承载 `openai.com` / `chatgpt.com` 规则的可切换策略组。
- 打开面板后自动测速，按延迟从低到高排列线路。
- 支持国家别名筛选，例如 `🇯🇵`、`日本`、`JP`；也可启用正则表达式进行锚点、开头结尾和或关系匹配。
- 可在列表中手动切换任意线路。

![OpenAI 路由面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techfanseric/ai-quota-bar/v1.5.0/docs/images/openai-route-recovery.png)

## 保守的自动恢复逻辑

自动切换只会在 `openai.com` 与 `chatgpt.com` 连续两轮同时不可达时触发。触发后会测速筛选结果，从最低延迟候选开始切换，并在每次切换后重新检查连通性；恢复成功后发送 macOS 系统通知。

打开面板、点击“重新测速”或勾选自动恢复开关都不会主动切换线路，从而避免频繁换线。自动恢复必须设置非空且有效的筛选条件。

## 兼容与安全

- 支持 Clash Verge Rev、Mihomo 与 Clash 的标准 external controller API。
- 只接受绑定到 `127.0.0.1`、`localhost` 或 `::1` 的控制器；远程控制器地址会被拒绝。
- 要求 macOS 14 或更高版本。

## 验证

- 从标签对应的干净提交构建。
- 57 项自动化测试全部通过。
- DMG 完整性、应用代码签名及镜像内外二进制一致性均已验证。
- DMG SHA-256：`251a0e3ccac9751e74e9d9e2aacbacaf6b8226f4ff8d1e56e65c5ba0d8970977`
body_en:
## Headline: OpenAI route auto-recovery

Right-click the menu bar icon to manage OpenAI routes directly — no more switching back to Clash:

- Auto-discovers the local controllers of Clash Verge Rev, Mihomo or Clash.
- Auto-locates the switchable strategy group carrying the `openai.com` / `chatgpt.com` rules.
- Tests speeds automatically when the panel opens, sorting routes by latency.
- Country alias filters like `🇯🇵`, `日本`, `JP`; regex mode supports anchors, start/end and OR matching.
- Any route can be switched manually from the list.

![OpenAI route panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/techfanseric/ai-quota-bar/v1.5.0/docs/images/openai-route-recovery.png)

## Conservative auto-recovery

Automatic switching triggers only when `openai.com` and `chatgpt.com` are unreachable together for two consecutive rounds. It then speed-tests the filtered results, switches starting from the lowest-latency candidate, and re-checks connectivity after each switch; success sends a macOS notification.

Opening the panel, clicking "Test again" or enabling auto-recovery never switches routes by itself, avoiding flapping. Auto-recovery requires a non-empty, valid filter.

## Compatibility & safety

- Supports the standard external controller APIs of Clash Verge Rev, Mihomo and Clash.
- Only controllers bound to `127.0.0.1`, `localhost` or `::1` are accepted; remote controller addresses are refused.
- Requires macOS 14 or later.

- **Area Chart Fill Path Fix**: Fixed incorrect area fill rendering where the left vertical edge was not properly drawn from the first data point to the x-axis (y=0). The previous implementation relied on `closeSubpath()` which doesn't draw a line segment, resulting in missing area fill at the left edge of the chart.

## Documentation

name: v1.1.0
body:
## Highlights
- Added automatic update checks (once every 24 hours).
- Added update notifications when a newer release is available.
- Fixed packaging issues that could cause the app to be reported as damaged.
- Fixed app icon display in the bundled `.app`.
- Added the `Applications` shortcut in the `.dmg` installer window.

## Update Behavior
- The app performs a background update check at most once per day.
- If a new version is found, a macOS notification is shown.
- Clicking the notification opens the release page.
- Manual update checks in Settings are still supported.

## Install
- Download `MiniMaxUsageMonitor.dmg` from this release.
- Drag `MiniMaxUsageMonitor.app` into `Applications`.

## v1.0.0 - First Release

MiniMax Usage Monitor is a macOS menu bar app for monitoring MiniMax API usage and quota.

### Features

- Menu bar widget displaying remaining quota
- Detailed usage view with per-model breakdown
- Quota trend charts for short-interval models
- Configurable refresh interval
- Warning notifications when quota runs low
- Secure API key storage via Keychain

### System Requirements

- macOS 14+
- MiniMax API Key

### Installation

1. Download `MiniMaxUsageMonitor.dmg`
2. Open the DMG file
3. Drag the app into Applications folder
4. Launch the app from Applications
5. Click the menu bar icon and select Settings to configure your API Key

## v1.0.0 - 首个版本

MiniMax Usage Monitor 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，用于监控 MiniMax API 的用量与配额。

### 功能

- 菜单栏小组件显示剩余配额
- 详细的用量视图，按模型拆分
- 短周期模型的配额趋势图表
- 可配置的刷新间隔
- 配额不足时发出警告通知
- 通过钥匙串安全存储 API Key

### 系统要求

- macOS 14+
- MiniMax API Key

### 安装步骤

1. 下载 `MiniMaxUsageMonitor.dmg`
2. 打开 DMG 文件
3. 将应用拖入“应用程序”文件夹
4. 从“应用程序”启动应用
5. 点击菜单栏图标，选择 Settings 配置你的 API Key
